/bin/bash -lc "cd [workspace path] && python3 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)
gray=a.mean(2)
# smooth columns, find strongest negative gradient (dark->light) between y 55..115
k=np.ones(3)/3
gs=np.apply_along_axis(lambda c: np.convolve(c,k,'same'),0,gray)
prof=[]
for x in range(0,256):
    d=np.diff(gs[55:118,x])
    y=55+np.argmax(d)
    prof.append(y)
prof=np.array(prof)
# print smoothed profile every 8 px
sm=np.convolve(prof,np.ones(5)/5,'same')
for x in range(0,256,8): print(x, prof[x], round(sm[x],1))
# save profile visualization
vis=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
for x in range(256): vis[prof[x],x]=[255,0,0]
Image.fromarray(vis).resize((1024,576),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save('.tmp/profile.png')
EOF"
